tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Mammoth Analytics docs and return the best-matching pages.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description:
Fetch one documentation page's full markdown content.

`path` may be a doc path ("learn/x.md"), a site route ("/learn/x"),
or a full docs URL (including a ".md"-suffixed one).

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List published documentation pages, optionally filtered by section.
